name: host-member-turn-failed
description: Teams Phase 2 (D.3): billing takes support's ask, and a pre-dispatch error ends the turn (turn_completed{error}). Only the turn ends: the same append bounces the ask turn_failed with the error and records member_idle{turn_failed}; billing's row is idle and keeps no new result, and no member_ended is written. support closes the ask failed with the same error.
